svg.title: Same service, two servers: load per CPU shows which one is saturated
svg.desc: Infographic comparing Server A and Server B load per CPU to diagnose CPU saturation.

text.tspan: load per CPU shows which one is saturated

g.text: 3 vmstat run queue matches the load, little disk or network I/O, so it is CPU load

text.tspan: 4 book estimate: 85 / 48 - 1 = threads wait about 77 percent of the time,
roughly four times faster without the waiting

g.text: Server A is CPU saturated, so its latency is queueing time.
